watch.purpose: Micro-detail, material texture, tiny text, exact geometry, and refraction.
watch.prompt: Photorealistic macro product photograph of a mechanical wristwatch lying on folded dark navy wool, viewed at a three-quarter angle. Brushed stainless-steel case, domed sapphire crystal with a crisp curved reflection, black dial. Exactly 12 hour markers with fine minute ticks; three hands show 10:08:37. On the lower dial, tiny but legible uppercase engraving reads exactly: FLARE QUALITY TEST. One clear water droplet rests on the crystal at 2 o'clock and visibly refracts the nearby tick marks. Show subtle hairline scratches in the steel, individual wool fibres, fine concentric machining on the crown, and crisp knurled crown ridges. Soft studio lighting, realistic shadows, shallow depth of field, premium catalogue photography. No other text.

transit.purpose: Dense typography, exact strings, aligned layout, icon-text association, and small structured information.
transit.prompt: Design a clean, flat, modern metro information poster on an off-white background, portrait orientation, viewed perfectly front-on with no perspective. At the top, large navy title text exactly: NIGHT OWL LINE. Below it, a horizontal route with exactly five circular station nodes connected by one navy line. Label the nodes left-to-right exactly: HARBOR, MUSEUM, CENTRAL, MARKET, AIRPORT. Under the route, make a timetable with exactly four rows and three aligned columns headed exactly: TRAIN, DEPARTS, PLATFORM. The four rows must read exactly: N1 | 23:40 | 2; N2 | 00:20 | 4; N3 | 01:10 | 1; N4 | 02:05 | 3. Beside each row, include a different simple line icon: crescent moon, suitcase, coffee cup, bicycle. Near the bottom, put a yellow warning box containing exactly: LAST TRAIN MAY SKIP MARKET. At the very bottom in tiny but legible text write exactly: Valid Friday and Saturday only. Keep every supplied word and number spelled exactly as given. No other text, no logos, no decorative fake lettering. Swiss transit graphic design, strict grid, generous whitespace, razor-sharp typography.

barista.purpose: Multi-scale photorealistic detail: skin, hair, fabric, metal, glass, steam, condensation, reflections, printed microtext, and busy depth.
barista.prompt: Ultra-realistic editorial photograph inside a small specialty coffee shop on a rainy evening. A barista in the foreground pours a thin stream of steamed milk into a ceramic cappuccino, making a crisp six-leaf rosetta. Show natural skin pores and tiny freckles on the hand, individual arm hairs, a dark green ribbed cotton apron with visible weave and a few flour specks, and a brushed-steel milk pitcher with fine hairline scratches. On the counter are a clear glass of sparkling water covered in tiny condensation droplets, three scattered coffee beans, a stainless teaspoon, and a folded kraft-paper receipt. The receipt has one small but legible printed line exactly: TABLE 7 — FLAT WHITE. Behind the barista, show an espresso machine with chrome reflections, translucent rising steam, stacked ceramic cups, glass jars of beans, and a rain-streaked window reflecting warm pendant lights and a blurry red bicycle outside. Preserve realistic transparent glass, believable reflections, subtle depth of field, accurate fingers, physically plausible liquid and steam, rich but natural low-light detail. No extra readable text.

portrait.purpose: Maximum-resolution surface-detail stress test: skin pores, vellus hair, iris fibres, eyelashes, flyaway curls, knitted wool, and brushed metal.
portrait.prompt: Ultra-realistic unretouched beauty-editorial portrait, perfectly front-facing and centered, of a woman in her mid-30s with naturally freckled light-brown skin and dark curly hair. Square composition; her head and upper shoulders fill almost the entire frame, with both eyes sharply in focus and the face occupying about 75% of the image width. Neutral warm-gray studio background, one large softbox slightly camera-left, natural color, no glamour retouching and no skin smoothing. Resolve extremely fine real-world surface detail: distinct pores across the nose and cheeks; tiny vellus peach-fuzz hairs catching side light; irregular freckles of different sizes and densities; one faint healed 8 mm scar on the left cheek; individual eyebrow hairs; separate upper and lower eyelashes; fine radial fibres and color variation in both irises; subtle wet tear-line reflections; natural lip lines and slight dry texture; individual flyaway hairs and fine frizz around the hairline. She wears a charcoal-gray chunky knitted wool turtleneck whose individual yarn fibres, twisted strands and knit loops are clearly visible, plus one simple brushed-titanium hoop earring showing very fine directional brushing and a few microscopic hairline scratches. Preserve believable human skin and anatomy. The image should reward inspection at 100% zoom: photographic microcontrast and natural high-frequency texture without artificial sharpening, plastic skin, painterly texture, beauty-filter smoothing, fake grain, text, jewelry other than the single hoop, or background objects.
